entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Iraqi News Agency (INA), is an Iraqi Baghdad-based public service broadcaster established in March 1959 during the reign of Abdul Karim Qasim. It is the second oldest news agency among Arab countries after the Middle East News Agency in Egypt, which was established in 1955.
